summary: This tutorial explains how to apply backgrounds and customize designs in LibreOffice Impress, using versions compatible with Linux. It covers setting up a custom background for all slides by modifying the slide master. To do this, you first open a sample presentation and select the 'View' menu to access the slide master. Here, you can edit the master slide, which affects all slides in the presentation. For a white background, you choose the 'Format' menu, then 'Page', and select 'Page Setup'. In the dialog box, choose 'Bitmap' from the 'Fill' dropdown, then 'Blank'. For better text visibility, change the text color to black. To add elements like logos or shapes, use the 'Basic Shapes' toolbar to draw rectangles or other shapes on the slide. You can resize and reposition these shapes using the control points around them. This tutorial also demonstrates adding different shapes and adjusting their size and position on the slide.
